narrative: On the almanack. The penny almanac held at the lodging window. The same printed line. The margin is still clear. Grey light on the page. On the almanack. He turns to the week's column and back to the day. No mark of his hand on either leaf. On the almanack. The almanac closed on the sill, the clasp not fastened. The street door is in the same grey light, out of the page.
